topic: South Orange County, CA (Aliso Viejo, Laguna Niguel, Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, Mission Viejo, Dana Point, San Juan Capistrano, San Clemente, Irvine, Newport Beach) dental-lab market assessment for Integra Dental Design / Bear Milling
summary:
Bottom line: South Orange County is one of the most lab-saturated dental markets in the United States, and nothing found in this pass supports calling it underserved. The county contains the world's largest dental lab (Glidewell: ~1M sq ft in Irvine/Newport Beach, ~5,000 employees, 100,000+ units/week, 24,000 dentists sending work weekly, 3-day BruxZir, $9 FedEx overnight each way), the Irvine support center of the third-largest DSO (PDS Health, 1,381 OC employees, nearly every supported office running CEREC), Smile Brands' HQ, Western Dental's HQ, and a dense tail of independent labs in Irvine, Santa Ana, Anaheim, Garden Grove and Westminster. The most lucrative south-OC full-arch practices (Wöhrle, Providence Prosthodontics, Laguna Hills Prosthodontics, Aliso Viejo Family Dental, 4M, New Life, Same Day Smile Designs) already own in-house labs or mills.

Facts (sourced): Orange County Dental Society reports 2,500+ active members and is California's largest component (ocds.org, undated; third-party figure 2,530 at Jan 2025). UCLA CHPR's 2021 table puts Orange County at 5.3 dentists per 5,000 residents (2020 Dental Board data), which on ~3.17M residents implies roughly 3,300-3,400 licensed dentists; a directory lists 3,998. King County baseline: Seattle-King County Dental Society has ~1,476-1,700 members and UW CHWS reports 112 licensed dentists per 100,000 in King County (2023). State-level Census CBP (via a secondary compiler): California 734 dental-lab establishments vs Washington 175. Glidewell's published prices: BruxZir Full-Strength $109 ($89 digital model-free), screw-retained implant crown $339 (7 days in lab), BruxZir full-arch implant prosthesis $3,433 (Glidewell-affiliate price lists). Jim Glidewell (2022 interview): "the average laboratory crown in the United States is $150... we're at $99," ~$79-80 model-free. LMT LAB DAY West 2026 drew 1,600+ attendees and 131 exhibitors in Garden Grove (May 15-16, 2026); 2027 is May 14-15 at the same Hyatt Regency. TRI Dental Implants USA is registered in Dover, DE but its US support (949-676-7383) and lab (949-210-3877) lines are Orange County numbers, its Area Sales Director is based in Irvine, and it runs study clubs in Irvine; no OC street address was found.

Estimates (labeled): County-level CBP NAICS 339116 counts could not be retrieved (API key required; data.census.gov is script-rendered; curl blocked). Using state CBP totals and directory shares, Orange County plausibly has ~90-120 payroll lab establishments plus Glidewell's ~1,400-1,500 OC lab employees, versus ~55-70 in King County. That is roughly one independent lab per 30 dentists in OC versus one per 40 in King County, before counting Glidewell, so lab supply per dentist in OC is higher, not lower, than Integra's home market. Scraped directory listings (April 2026) show ~330 "dental laboratory" listings across OC cities (Anaheim 49, Irvine 31, Buena Park 25, Orange 24, Garden Grove 22, Santa Ana 21...), inflated by in-office labs and misclassification. The 10 target cities hold roughly 25% of OC population, implying ~800-1,000 dentists (estimate). In-office milling: one query surfaced ~10 independent CEREC/E4D/Roland practices in the target cities plus every PDS-supported office; PDS itself cites <10% national chairside-CAD/CAM penetration, so 10-20% of south-OC GP practices is a reasonable estimate.

Pricing comparison: Integra's $129 full-contour zirconia is $20-$40 above Glidewell and at the top of local independent lists ($85-$125). e.max at $149 is parity with Glidewell. Integra's implant crown package ($269-$299) undercuts Glidewell's $339 screw-retained and $432-$454 custom-abutment packages. Integra's $1,700 full-arch zirconia and $2,200 ti-bar undercut Glidewell ($3,433) and ADL ($3,750) but an Irvine lab (Avant Dental Arts) advertises full zirconia hybrid arches "from $899" on sale (list $3,450), and lab-to-lab price lists show full-arch zirconia at $999-$1,999 and FCZ at $39-$59, so Bear Milling's $22 mill-only and $650 full-arch are price-competitive only at the wholesale tier.

Turnaround and shipping: Glidewell sets expectations at 3 days in lab (next-day available for digital cases), $9 FedEx overnight each way or free USPS Priority, plus scheduled in-office pickup. Local labs advertise 3-5 day turnaround, courier pickup (OD's, IDOC), and one Laguna Hills lab offers 4-hour same-day zirconia within 10 miles. A Bellevue lab with 3 days in-lab plus two shipping legs lands at 5-8 calendar days door-to-door for physical cases, slower than the local norm; digital-impression cases remove the inbound leg.

Reach channels: OCDS (Orange, CA), West Coast Study Club (Seattle Study Club affiliate, co-directors Drs. Jin Kim and Gianmarco O'Brien), Dental Implants GPS Full-Arch Study Club (South OC/North OC, quarterly, free), "Wednesdays with the Specialists" held at Keating Dental Lab in Irvine, Glidewell Study Club ($495/yr), Osseointegration Study Club of Southern California, Implant Study Group of Southern California, TRI USA Irvine study clubs, and LAB DAY West. Harbor Dental Society covers Long Beach/South Bay plus only the northwest OC fringe (Seal Beach, Los Alamitos, Rossmoor, Surfside), not south OC.

Honest switching assessment: A dentist in Laguna Niguel has Glidewell 20 minutes away, a dozen independent labs offering courier pickup within 15 miles, and probably a CEREC down the hall. The reasons to try a Bellevue lab reduce to (1) a personal relationship, (2) an implant-crown and full-arch price that beats Glidewell by $40-$1,700, (3) a TRI matrix certification niche once completed, and (4) equipment/lab-to-lab selling to OC's small labs and in-office millers, which is a different business than selling crowns to dentists. Winning dentist accounts without a local pickup/shade/try-in presence is unlikely; the local-office idea only works if it buys courier-level service, and that cost was not researched here.

findings.claim: Orange County Dental Society membership and scope
findings.value: 2,500+ active members; 50+ new members/yr; largest of California's 32 components; 10% of CDA members
findings.detail: OCDS serves all 10 target cities (Aliso Viejo through Newport Beach). Office: 790 The City Drive South Ste 450, Orange, CA 92868, (714) 634-8944. A third-party profile (ZoomInfo) gives 2,530 members as of Jan 2025.

findings.claim: Dentists per capita, Orange County
findings.value: 5.3 dentists per 5,000 population (≈1 per 943 residents)
findings.detail: UCLA Center for Health Policy Research table using 2020 Dental Licensing Board, CHIS 2018-19, CHHS and CDA data. Applied to ~3.17M residents this implies ≈3,360 licensed dentists in OC (estimate). Marin 5.1, Santa Clara 5.6, SF 6.1, LA 3.6 for comparison.

findings.claim: Alternative OC dentist counts
findings.value: ~2,460 (Dentx population-share estimate, 2026-06-08); 3,998 (FindClarity directory, undated)
findings.detail: Dentx explicitly derives its number by applying OC's ~8% population share to ADA HPI's 30,280 active California dentists; it is not a count. FindClarity is a consumer directory. The UCLA ratio and OCDS membership (2,500+ members, typically ~60-70% market share for tripartite societies) are more consistent with ~3,000-3,400 licensed dentists.

findings.claim: Dentists in the 10 target south-OC cities
findings.value: ≈800-1,000 practicing dentists (estimate)
findings.detail: Basis: the ten cities hold roughly 790K residents (≈25% of OC); applying 5.3/5,000 gives ≈840; coastal affluent cities likely run above county average. No city-level primary count found.

findings.claim: King County, WA dentist baseline
findings.value: SKCDS ≈1,476 members (May 31, 2024, Form 990); 'almost 1,700' per website; 112 licensed dentists per 100,000 in King County (2023, UW CHWS)
findings.detail: 112/100k on ~2.27M residents implies ≈2,500 dentists with a WA license address in King County (estimate). OC's 5.3/5,000 = 106/100k, so dentist density is similar in both counties.
findings.source_date: undated page citing 2023 data (accessed 2026-10-12); SKCDS 990 via https://siviq.co/nonprofits/organizations/910520407/seattle-king-county-dental-society/returns/202530729349300133/2024

findings.claim: Census CBP NAICS 339116 county counts for Orange County CA and King County WA could not be retrieved
findings.value: unresolved
findings.detail: api.census.gov returned 'Missing Key' for 2021 and 2022 CBP queries; data.census.gov tables are script-rendered; BLS QCEW CSV fetch failed (content-type) and curl is blocked by the sandbox proxy (403). State-level CBP via a secondary compiler: California 734 establishments (15.4% of US), Washington 175 (3.7%). Older Encyclopedia.com CBP table: CA 1,046, WA 270 (c. 2002-2006).

findings.claim: Estimated lab establishments: Orange County vs King County
findings.value: OC ≈90-120 payroll labs (plus Glidewell ≈1,400-1,500 OC lab employees); King County ≈55-70 payroll labs
findings.detail: Basis: CA 734 × 12-16% OC share (OC cities are ~16% of CA scraped lab listings; 8% of population) and WA 175 × 32-40% King share. Implied ≈1 independent lab per 30 dentists in OC vs ≈1 per 40 in King County, before counting Glidewell. Directory cross-checks: WhereOrg lists ~115 OC lab entries (undated); RentechDigital (Apr 1 2026) lists ~330 across OC cities (Anaheim 49, Irvine 31, Buena Park 25, Orange 24, Garden Grove 22, Santa Ana 21, Fullerton 20, Huntington Beach 20, Tustin 18, Brea 10, Westminster 10, Newport Beach 9, Lake Forest 7, Mission Viejo 7, Aliso Viejo 5, Laguna Hills 5, San Clemente 5, Dana Point 4). Scraped listings over-count (in-office labs, misclassified firms).

findings.claim: Glidewell scale and location
findings.value: ~1,000,000 sq ft Irvine/Newport Beach campus; ~5,000 employees (1,381 in OC per OCBJ Aug 2026 list); 100,000+ units/week; 24,000 dentists send work every week, ~70,000/yr
findings.detail: HQ 4141 MacArthur Blvd, Newport Beach 92660; main campus 2201 Dupont Dr, Irvine 92612; manufactures its own BruxZir zirconia (sold to other labs) and glidewell.io chairside mills; 265 employees in Costa Rica. PDS Health passed Glidewell as OC's largest dental employer in 2026.
findings.source_date: 2025-08-12 (accessed 2026-10-12); volume metrics from https://www.groupdentistrynow.com/dso-group-blog/the-group-dentistry-now-show-the-voice-of-the-dso-industry-episode-74/ (2022-01-05); OC headcount from https://www.ocbj.com/healthcare/pds-health-becomes-ocs-largest-dental-co/ (2026-08-03)

findings.claim: Glidewell published crown prices and turnaround
findings.value: BruxZir Full-Strength $109 ($89 model-free digital); BruxZir Esthetic $119 ($99); BruxZir Radiant $149 ($129); 3 days in lab; Next-Day BruxZir for digital cases (scan by 2 p.m., receive 10:30 a.m. next day, up to 3 units)
findings.detail: Per-unit, excluding shipping/tax. Jim Glidewell, 2022: 'the average laboratory crown in the United States is $150... we're at $99' and ~$79-80 without model work.
findings.source_date: page dated 2019-09-08, prices current on page (accessed 2026-10-12); digital prices confirmed in https://glidewelldental.com/company/blog/bruxzir-zirconia-restorative-dentistrys-recession-buster (2024-12-10)

findings.claim: Glidewell implant and full-arch prices
findings.value: Screw-retained crown (Ti-base) $339, 7 days in lab; BruxZir crown over custom abutment $432-$454 (13 days); BruxZir full-arch implant prosthesis $3,433 incl. up to 6 MUAs and two try-ins; screw-retained hybrid with milled Ti bar $2,335
findings.detail: Screw-retained price from glidewelldental.com; package and full-arch prices from Glidewell-affiliate price lists (Riverside Dental Ceramics, Crown World) that mirror Glidewell's schedule. Flat-rate applies to ~15 major implant systems; OEM-part systems cost more.
findings.source_date: page dated 2019-09-05, prices current (accessed 2026-10-12); full-arch from https://riversidelab.com/price-list/ (undated) and https://crownworlddental.com/lab-services-2025/ (2025-09-10)

findings.claim: How dentists ship cases to the dominant local lab
findings.value: FedEx Overnight $9 each way ($18 round trip) using Glidewell-preprinted labels; prepaid USPS Priority labels free (2-4 business days each way); scheduled in-office pickup; bundling multiple cases per box
findings.detail: Glidewell says 'most practices are moving to digital submission through My Account.' This sets south-OC expectations: shipping is effectively free and door-to-door turnaround for a 3-day crown is ~5-6 calendar days.

findings.claim: Local independent lab turnaround norms in OC
findings.value: 3 days (Creative Image, Laguna Hills; 38 Smiles, Fountain Valley); 3-5 business days (IDOC); 5 working days model-free zirconia (Artidental, Irvine); 12 business days (Pro Arts, City of Industry); same-day 4-hour posterior zirconia within 10 miles (Creative Image)
findings.detail: Several labs offer driver pickup (OD's Dental Laboratory pickup line 1-800-887-7073; IDOC 'free pickup from your office... local service in Orange County').
findings.source_date: undated (accessed 2026-10-12); IDOC https://www.idocdentallab.com/; 38 Smiles https://38smileslab.com/; Artidental https://www.artidentallab.com/

findings.claim: Local/lab-to-lab price points for zirconia and full-arch
findings.value: Avant Dental Arts (Irvine) full zirconia hybrid arch 'from $899' sale (regular $3,450); ADL ZirBrux $109, implant crown package $559, full-arch zirconia bridge $3,750 (2024); Mabel lab-to-lab (Jan 2026) FCZ $59, coping $39, screw-retained FCZ $189, full-arch zirconia $999-$1,999; NDX Pacific alliance schedule (2020) FCZ $49/$44 modeless; TDL FCZ $85-$99
findings.detail: Mabel, ADL, TDL locations not verified as OC; included as lab-to-lab/regional benchmarks. Integra's $129 FCZ sits above Glidewell and at the top of local independents; implant crown $269-$299 is below Glidewell's $339; full-arch $1,700 is below Glidewell/ADL but above Avant's promotional $899; Bear Milling $22 mill-only is below Mabel's $39 coping and $650 full-arch is below Mabel's $999 copy-mill.

findings.claim: National labs serving OC and whether they have local facilities
findings.value: Glidewell: local (Irvine/Newport Beach). NDX: nearest labs NDX Pacific (Manhattan Beach), Burbank Dental Lab (NDX since Jan 2023), none in OC. Dandy: NYC HQ, Texas manufacturing, ships nationally, free scanner, 5-day zirconia; no OC facility. DDS Lab (national, Tampa): no OC facility found; 'The DDS Lab' at 434 S Euclid St #200, Anaheim is an unrelated local lab.
findings.detail: Keating Dental Lab (Irvine) is itself a national-scale lab ('thousands of practices across the country'). Lab-to-lab milling centers found in the region: Glidewell (sells BruxZir to labs), GIE Dental Lab Glendale (DGSHAPE DWX-53DC + DWX-52DCi + Asiga MAX UV), Digital Smile Solutions (SoCal, full-arch only, in-house milling).

findings.claim: PDS Health presence and CEREC saturation
findings.value: 1,381 OC employees (Irvine support center, largest in network); HQ moved to Henderson NV 2024; 1,000+ supported practices in 24 states; 'nearly all' supported practices offer CEREC; 3.75M lifetime CEREC restorations, 427,000 in 2023; PDS cites <10% of US dentists offer chairside CAD/CAM
findings.detail: PDS affiliate lab+supply cost reported at 8.5% of collections (2012) due to CEREC. No evidence found of a PDS-owned central dental lab in OC (unresolved).

findings.claim: Other OC-headquartered DSOs
findings.value: Smile Brands (Irvine): 7,500 employees, ~$1B sales, 600+ offices in 29 states (Bright Now!, Monarch, Castle). Western Dental & Orthodontics (Orange, CA): 260+ locations CA/AZ, ~1,200 dentists (2022). Envista Holdings (Brea): implant/equipment maker.
findings.detail: Whether Smile Brands or Western Dental operate captive labs was not confirmed (unknown). Smile Brands has an Aspire Dental office in Irvine (13234 Jamboree Rd).

findings.claim: Dental Implants GPS / Implant Partnerships: full-arch referral group active in south OC
findings.value: Quarterly Full-Arch Study Club in South OC and North OC (free, 2 CE); Spear Educational Series hosted by Niguel Coast Oral & Facial Surgery; South OC Hygiene Study Club at Marbella Country Club
findings.detail: Drs. Eric Baker and Tim Betita; co-managed All-on-4 model where GP refers and GPS does surgery/prosthetics; network partners quoted include Viviane Stein DDS (Laguna Beach) and Nicole Kuske DDS. 2026 South OC dates: Jan 20, Apr 9, Jul 16, Oct 8.

findings.claim: West Coast Study Club (Seattle Study Club affiliate)
findings.value: Est. 1999 as Orange County Dental Implant Institute; SSC affiliate since 2019; 9-11 sessions/yr, ~43-46 CEU; 2023-24 dues $3,650 practice owner, $2,450 dental lab technician; symposium in Brea
findings.detail: Co-directors Dr. Jin Y. Kim (periodontist) and Dr. Gianmarco O'Brien. Lab-technician membership tier means a lab owner can join as a member rather than a sponsor.

findings.claim: 'Wednesdays with the Specialists' Orange County Dental Study Club meets inside a competitor lab
findings.value: 3rd Wednesday monthly, 5:30-8:00 PM, at Keating Dental Lab, 16881 Hale Ave, Irvine; $120 for 8 sessions incl. dinner; 16 CE
findings.detail: Run by Irvine Oral Surgery & Dental Implant Center (Drs. Daniel Hsu, Jeffrey Nguyen). 2026 speakers include prosthodontists Baldwin and Chris Marchack and Dr. Brian Goodacre (Nobel-sponsored).

findings.claim: Other OC implant study clubs
findings.value: Glidewell Study Club ($495/yr, Thursdays, 2201 Dupont Dr Irvine, 50 dentists); Osseointegration Study Club of Southern California (est. 1985-86, ~40 active members incl. technologists); Implant Study Group of Southern California (Dr. Mark A. Cruz, Laguna Niguel, program director 2022-23); Periodontal, Implant & Restorative Study Club and Spear small group (Drs. Russo & Braga, Huntington Beach); Orange County Study Club (OC Perio, Orange) on hiatus since 2024; Pacific Coast Society for Prosthodontics (regional)
findings.detail: Dr. Mark Cruz (markacruzdds.com) is a long-tenured south-OC GP with memberships across nearly every regional implant/prostho study group and a Spear retreat at Monarch Beach; a natural networking node.

findings.claim: Harbor Dental Society does not cover south Orange County
findings.value: 749 dentists in 28 cities; coverage = Long Beach/South Bay LA County plus Seal Beach, Los Alamitos, Rossmoor, Surfside (northwest OC fringe)
findings.detail: Office: 4010 Watson Plaza Dr Ste 210, Lakewood, CA 90712. Shares an online CE forum and a Dental.com benefit with OCDS. Not a channel to Aliso Viejo-Newport Beach dentists.

findings.claim: LMT LAB DAY West dates and scale
findings.value: 2026: May 15-16, Hyatt Regency Orange County, 11999 Harbor Blvd, Garden Grove; 1,600+ attendees, 131 exhibitors, 87 seminars. 2027: May 14-15, same venue
findings.detail: Largest West Coast lab show; relevant as the single densest gathering of OC/SoCal lab owners for ARUM/MillBox/hyperDENT dealer prospecting and Bear Milling lab-to-lab. Exhibitor pricing not published on fetched pages.

findings.claim: TRI Dental Implants USA: location and OC footprint
findings.value: Registered: TRI Dental Implants USA Inc., 1111B S Governors Ave Ste 48081, Dover, DE 19904. US Customer Support 949-676-7383; Lab line 949-210-3877 (Orange County area code). Area Sales Director Brett Jackson based in Irvine/Orange County (ex-Neodent OC territory manager who 'supported 30+ local dental laboratories'). Study club held in Irvine (Warehouse 72, 17900 Jamboree Rd) July 24, 2025.
findings.detail: No OC street address found; the Delaware address is a registered-agent suite. RocketReach lists ~47 employees globally, US sales led by EVP Dereck Fandel; hiring LA, SF Bay Area and Arizona territory reps in Jan and Sept 2026 posts. Senior Director of Clinical Affairs Dr. Amir Gordji is LA-based. Conclusion: TRI's US presence in OC is a field team, not a confirmed office.

findings.claim: Publicly identified TRI-matrix users in OC
findings.value: None found
findings.detail: TRI's SoCal study-club speaker Dr. Thomas R. Gonzales (Sedation and Implant Dentists) practices in San Gabriel, LA County, not OC. No OC dentist or lab was found publicly naming TRI matrix. Treat OC TRI demand as unproven.

findings.claim: In-office milling (CEREC/E4D/Roland) penetration among south-OC practices
findings.value: ≥10 named independent practices in the target cities plus essentially every PDS-supported office; estimated 10-20% of south-OC GP practices (estimate)
findings.detail: Named: OC Life Smiles (Newport Beach, CEREC), Newport Smile (355 Placentia Ave, CEREC), ProSmiles OC (Laguna Hills, CEREC + in-house lab), Laguna Hills Dental (24741 Alicia Pkwy, CEREC), Dr. Loberg (23141 Moulton Pkwy, Laguna Hills, CEREC), OC Premier Dentistry (Laguna Hills, E4D), Mission Ranch Dental Aesthetics (CEREC Primemill), Dentist of Mission Viejo (same-day milling), Dr. Claire Cho (Aliso Viejo, CEREC), Aliso Viejo Family Dental (Roland DWX-53DC), Providence Prosthodontics (Newport Beach, Zirkonzahn + TRIOS), Laguna Hills Prosthodontics (in-house mill), Dr. Christina Do (Costa Mesa, 'top five producer' on Glidewell fastmill.io). National baseline per PDS/Dentsply: <10% of US dentists. Affluent coastal demographics and PDS density push south OC above baseline.

findings.claim: Several of the highest-value south-OC implant/full-arch practices are vertically integrated with in-house labs
findings.value: Wöhrle (Newport Beach, ceramics lab + CT + robotic placement); Providence Prosthodontics (Newport Beach, Zirkonzahn mill); Laguna Hills Prosthodontics (Dr. Garbacea, in-house lab); Aliso Viejo Family Dental (Roland mill, master ceramist); 4M Dental Implant Center (Newport Beach, in-house lab, 24-hr teeth); New Life Dental Implant Center (Irvine, in-house lab); Same Day Smile Designs (Mission Viejo, in-house lab, photogrammetry, 3D printing)
findings.detail: These practices are equipment/consumable prospects (ARUM dealer) rather than lab-outsourcing prospects. Aliso Viejo Family Dental explicitly markets 'no mail delays, zero lab shipping errors' and says shipping an arch to an outside lab 'turns one appointment into three.'

findings.claim: Local full-arch fee levels (patient prices) in south OC
findings.value: All-on-4 $19,500-$25,000/arch (Aliso Viejo Family Dental); $19,000-$30,000/arch (Dentistry At Its Finest, Costa Mesa); from $10,000/arch (Teeth+Robots Irvine); single implant incl. crown from $1,995 (Premier Dental Implant Centers, Mission Viejo) to $3,500-$4,500 (AVFDG)
findings.detail: A $1,700 final zirconia arch is ~7-9% of a $19.5K-$25K patient fee, so lab cost is not the binding constraint for these practices; service, chairside support and conversion-day logistics are. The $1,995 single-implant price signals a discount tier that would value a $269-$299 implant crown package.

findings.claim: Some south-OC full-arch GPs explicitly rely on outside labs and digital designers
findings.value: Newport Beach Dental Studio (Dr. Tai Ha, 1441 Avocado Ave Ste 404): 'Complex full-arch treatment is coordinated between the restorative dentist, surgeon, laboratory team'; Aria Dental (Mission Viejo): iTero Element, 'we choose only local laboratories that follow American and California standards'
findings.detail: Aria's statement is direct evidence that 'local USA lab' is a selling point to patients in this market; a Bellevue lab is 'USA' but not 'local.' Dr. Ha completed the Full Arch Masters curriculum and is lab-dependent, a realistic Integra target type.

findings.claim: Labs serving OC with known 5-axis equipment (equipment-prospect intelligence)
findings.value: Aliso Viejo Family Dental Group: Roland DWX-53DC (dry 5-axis) in-office; Providence Prosthodontics (Newport Beach): Zirkonzahn mill + 3Shape TRIOS; GIE Dental Lab (Glendale): DGSHAPE DWX-53DC and DWX-52DCi wet mill + Asiga MAX UV; Wiand Dental Lab (markets to OC, located in Arizona): Ivoclar PM7; Rutherford Dental Lab (markets digitally): Ivoclar PM7, HeyGears printers; Glidewell: proprietary automated milling at scale
findings.detail: Practices running dry Roland/DGSHAPE mills cannot mill titanium bars or glass ceramics wet; that is the specific gap an ARUM 5X-200 wet mill or Bear Milling ti-bar service addresses.

findings.claim: Dentx characterizes OC dental competition as 'Very High' with Newport/Irvine 'Extreme'
findings.value: Est. Google Ads CPC $18-$30+ for cosmetic/implant keywords in Newport Beach; $12-$22 Irvine; $10-$16 South County
findings.detail: Marketing-vendor editorial estimate, not measured data; included only as directional evidence that implant-marketing costs in Newport/Irvine are high.

findings.claim: Dentist-facing lab marketing in OC emphasizes 'USA-made, never outsourced, local'
findings.value: Killian ('100% American-made... never outsource'), Artidental ('all our cases are fabricated in Irvine'), Keating ('ALL of our restorations are made in the USA'), DenTech ('No outsourcing - All restorations made in U.S.A.'), PRO-Craft ('100% U.S.-Based, Family-Owned')
findings.detail: Jim Glidewell (2022) noted DSOs buy from Vietnam/China labs at or below his $99. 'Local' is a stronger claim than 'USA' in this market; Integra can claim USA but not local.

findings.claim: Bellevue-to-south-OC shipping and turnaround for physical cases
findings.value: Estimate: 2 business days each way by UPS/FedEx Ground WA→CA; retail small-box 2-Day/Standard Overnight ≈$20-$45 each way without a negotiated contract; door-to-door ≈5-8 calendar days for a 3-day in-lab crown
findings.detail: No carrier page was fetched (fedex.com blocks crawlers); figures are experience-based estimates. Glidewell's $9 overnight each way and local labs' free courier pickup set the comparison. Digital-impression cases remove the inbound leg; only outbound applies.

findings.claim: OC dental-industry employment context
findings.value: OCBJ 2025 list: 5,270 OC employees across dental companies (-5% YoY); PDS 1,293; 2026 list: PDS 1,381 (No.1), Glidewell No.2
findings.detail: Shows the county's dental supply chain (labs, DSOs, device makers incl. Envista/Brea) is large and consolidating around a few employers.
